title: Yikes! Florida Receptionist Reportedly Arrested After Receiving $400K In Overpay She Thought Was A Bonus - NewsBreak
text: Whew, chile! A Florida woman, Yessica Arrua , thought she hit the jackpot at her 9-to-5—but now she’s facing serious charges after some mysterious money started showing up in her account. And let’s just say… sis didn’t exactly call HR to double-check. The internet is buzzing with folks defending Yessica, saying the whole mess is on the clinic and payroll company for letting this overpayment slide for so long. Additionally, People are wondering how a $450K-a-year vet didn’t even notice the missing money while the receptionist got caught up in the chaos. From ikyfl.tv’s Instagram comments to X, the mood online is all about why the receptionist is the one taking the fall. One Instagram user @ _.daesmain said, “ How is that her fault? “ Meanwhile, Instagram user @ t3istedt4ngled wrote, “ How is that her fault?? They paid her that money, she thought it was a bonus this shouldn’t even hold up in court “ And, Instagram user @ lyu.mooni added, “ atleast she thought abt others free her shes innocent “ While, Instagram user @ indatbag.laay commented, “ Now how is that her fault? Everyone would’ve done the same “ This Instagram user bossvalid__ said, “ I’d be arrested too:FREE SISS ” Then, Instagram user @ jennythebody wrote, “ But how though? PAYROLL DID A ERROR. “ Folks also took to X to speak out, adding: According to the police report , Yessica Arrua didn’t just ball out for herself—she spread the wealth too. Thousands were sent to “Mama Dukes” via Zelle, and the “gift from god” allegedly made its way to Argentina, for her family to build a house. To top it off, when police finally got in touch with the payroll company, Harbor America , they learned that folks with knowledge of the error were no longer employed. Meanwhile, the clinic’s president , who’s known Yessica since she was nine years old, turned her in after she got caught slippin’. When confronted, she reportedly broke down, admitted everything, and handed over a $200K cashier’s check. Additionally, she claimed the rest was long gone. Now, sis is reportedly sitting in Palm Beach’s detention center. The post appeared first on .
